source_caption_text:
🎥 While fans are discussing the possibility of a Migos tour comeback, Offset is keeping the spotlight on his solo music with the release of a video for his new track, “Something I Need”. 

But the release itself wasn’t the only thing that caught viewers’ attention. The 1win logo was spotted in the video. 💎

It looks like 1win is becoming increasingly active in the rap scene. Just recently, the brand was also spotted in Ice Spice and Lil Yachty’s “Out My Face”

Two notable rap releases  and the same brand appearing in both. Coincidence, or is this part of a new 1win strategy for working with the music industry?

It’ll be interesting to see which artist is next and what kind of collaboration the brand comes up with 👀
